### 1.  “Even stickers are visible”

Sticker \(2\) is visible  \(\Longleftrightarrow\)  after roll 2 the face \(f_2\) never

* Choose \(f_3\): any face except \(f_2\) – 5 ways.
* Choose \(f_5\): any face except \(f_2\) or \(f_4\) – 4 ways.

Thus  

\[
\#\{\text{sequences with all evens visible}\}=120\cdot6\cdot5\cdot4=14400 .
\]

Since there are \(6^{6}=46656\) possible sequences,

\[
P(E)=\frac{14400}{46656}= \frac{25}{81}.
\]

### 2.  “Exactly one face is blank”

A blank face never occurs in the sequence.
